title: The spending is public. The source isn’t.
description: Contrast card linking the money ledger: what the FEC filings show ($11,077,173 opposing Platner, 97¢ through one super PAC, six checks, one vendor) vs what no filing shows (who funded the nonprofit that gave the PAC $3,000,000).
alt_text: Dark card: The spending is public. The source isn’t. Green card, what the FEC filings show: $11,077,173 spent opposing Platner, 97 cents of it through one super PAC, six checks, one ad vendor, every receipt linked. Amber card, what no filing shows: who funded the nonprofit that gave that PAC $3,000,000 — no filing exists, none is required. Amber italic: Public where the law makes it public. Dark where it doesn’t.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
